cds.title: Troy University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF; file page headers still read 2024-2025 but the data are Fall 2025)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025). International applicants: 960 applied, 949 admitted (98.9%), 56 enrolled. The file is posted as the 2025-2026 edition but its page headers still read 2024-2025; its figures are for Fall 2025 (the 2024-2025 file has Fall 2024 data). Enrollment figures cover Troy University as a whole (Troy, Dothan, Montgomery, Phenix City campuses and online): total undergraduates 10,130 and nonresidents 435. SAT scores were sent by 5% (89 students) and ACT scores by 50% (906). Test-optional for students starting in 2027. No early decision/action; no waitlist; rolling decisions. The admission factor checkboxes could not be read, so admission factors are not shown.

cost.notes: The Common Data Set gives tuition, fees and room and board. International tuition and the total cost of attendance come from Troy's international tuition page (2026-27 estimate for the Troy campus at 13 credit hours a semester at $746 per credit hour: tuition $19,864, fee $3,250, insurance $1,860, book bag $624, room $7,000, board $4,456, supplies $200 = $37,254; $27,322 after the $9,932 International Trojan Opportunity scholarship). The Common Data Set shows 351 nonresidents received institutional non-need-based aid (average $15,702, total $5,512,833)
